title: File an STR and dispute a result

scenes.say: When you suspect money laundering, you must report it to the Financial Reporting Centre, the FRC. And when you think a check got it wrong, you can ask DeepTrack to look again. This video covers both: STRs and disputes.

show.card: File an STR and dispute a result
show.subtitle: Sentinel by DeepTrack · Analyst training

scenes.say: There are two kinds of report. An STR is about a specific transaction, like a cash deposit. A SAR is about activity with no single transaction, such as a sanctioned person trying to open an account. Only Admins and Reviewers can prepare them.

show.subtitle: STR: a suspicious transaction · SAR: suspicious activity, no transaction

scenes.say: Here is a structuring alert on Wanjiku Mwangi. Click Transactions, choose Escalated, and open the alert. An analyst escalated it: three cash deposits, each just under the reporting threshold.
Scroll to the Suspicious transaction report panel at the bottom. It appears because the alert's customer reference is a Sentinel check, so Sentinel knows who the customer is.

Click Prepare STR to open the window. From an alert, STR is already selected. Sentinel fills in the reason, the action taken and the largest transaction. Rewrite the reason in your own words, check the amount, then click Prepare and download.

show.card: Prepare a report for the FRC
show.subtitle: Reason for suspicion · Action taken · The transaction → Prepare and download

scenes.say: Sentinel saves a draft and downloads a goAML file. Sentinel never sends anything to the FRC. You check the file and submit it in goAML yourself. Here, the draft is waiting.

When goAML gives you a reference, come back and click Mark submitted, then enter it exactly. This can't be undone. And never tell the customer you're reporting them. That's tipping-off, an offence under Kenyan law.

Now disputes. Click Disputes in the menu. A dispute asks DeepTrack's review team to look at a result again, and your team can't decide it. Demo Bank has disputed James Mutua's rejection, and it's marked With DeepTrack.
Under it is the reason the team gave: the customer was verified in person at the Westlands branch on the same day. Give facts DeepTrack can check. Click the name to open the report.

The report shows a banner: Disputed, DeepTrack is reviewing this result. The current result stays until DeepTrack decides. If the dispute is no longer needed, for example when the customer brings new documents, you can withdraw it here.

show.highlight: case:Disputed: DeepTrack is reviewing this result

scenes.say: To send a dispute, click Dispute this result at the top of a report. It shows only for a pass or a rejection from the last 90 days, with no open review case. Explain why the result is wrong, then click Send dispute.

show.subtitle: Why is the result wrong? → Send dispute

scenes.say: When DeepTrack decides, you get a notification. Upheld means the result changed. Not upheld means it stays. Either way, DeepTrack's note explains why.

show.card: With DeepTrack · Upheld · Not upheld · Withdrawn
show.subtitle: You're notified in the app and by email when DeepTrack decides

scenes.say: That's STRs and disputes. To learn more, open chapters B14 and B15 in Help.

show.card: Help → B14 Filing an STR or SAR · B15 Disputes
show.subtitle: sentinel.deeptrack.io/help/b14 · sentinel.deeptrack.io/help/b15

notes: Recording must run as an Admin or Reviewer, or the Suspicious transaction report panel (and Prepare STR, goAML XML, Mark submitted) won't render on the alert page.
Prepare STR only opens a dialog, but per the rules it is highlighted, not clicked; the dialog is shown as a title card.

'case:Escalated as suspicious', 'case:draft, not yet submitted', 'case:With DeepTrack', 'case:Westlands' and 'case:Disputed: DeepTrack is reviewing this result' rely on the page.getByText fallback (first match).
The disputes list only links the customer name when verification.href is set; assumed true for James Mutua's KYC check.

Dispute this result doesn't render on James Mutua's report (already disputed, so it shows the banner and Withdraw instead), so sending a dispute is a title card. If the dispute is withdrawn or decided before recording, the banner scene breaks.
The Disputes sidebar click happens from the alert page; no goto needed, but add goto /dashboard first if the sidebar is collapsed.
